t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Rather than focusing on the color of the gnomes, it is better to pick the gnome on the right when the reward is x5.

vb_textbox.text: I found that when the rewatd was x5 selecting the one on the right netted a higher amount. When the reward was x1 the only pattern I found was if the choice was between a pointed and a flat mushroom, the pointy one was worth more.
